records.source: That was great. I'm pretty sure I even saw my cabin in one of those Stardew Valley aerial shots!$h
records.translation: Napakaganda niyon. Halos tiyak akong nakita ko pa ang Kubo ko sa isa sa mga kuha ng Stardew Valley mula sa himpapawid!$h

records.source: I'm really intrigued by this movie... I'm a sucker for the mysterious.
records.translation: Talagang napukaw ng pelikulang ito ang interes ko... Hindi ko mapigilan ang sarili ko sa anumang misteryoso.

records.source: That was great! The narrative was very loose, but I think it was intended to speak to the emotions, not the intellect.
records.translation: Napakaganda niyon! Napakalaya ng pagkakabuo ng salaysay, pero sa palagay ko ay nilayon nitong pukawin ang damdamin, hindi ang isip.

records.source: I'm not sure what to expect with this movie, but I'm going to keep an open mind!
records.translation: Hindi ko tiyak kung ano ang aasahan sa pelikulang ito, pero pananatilihin kong bukas ang isip ko!

records.source: That was simple, but good... It's like the comfort food of cinema.
records.translation: Payak iyon, pero maganda... Para itong pagkaing nagbibigay-ginhawa sa mundo ng sine.

records.source: From the movie poster, this one looks pretty cheesy.
records.translation: Batay sa poster, mukhang medyo baduy ang pelikulang ito.

records.source: That was kind of lowbrow, wasn't it?
records.translation: Medyo mababaw iyon, hindi ba?

records.source: I'm so happy to have an excuse to come to Pelican Town!
records.translation: Tuwang-tuwa akong may dahilan akong pumunta sa Bayan ng Pelican!

records.source: That was a lot of fun, thanks for inviting me! I'd better head home soon...
records.translation: Napakasaya niyon, salamat sa pag-imbita sa akin! Mabuti pang umuwi na ako maya-maya...

records.source: I foresee this to be an exquisite night!
records.translation: Nakikita kong magiging katangi-tangi ang gabing ito!

records.source: I feel as if my spirit is charged... as if the energy of the film was transferred to me. Incredible!
records.translation: Pakiramdam ko ay napuno ng lakas ang aking diwa... na para bang lumipat sa akin ang enerhiya ng pelikula. Pambihira!

records.source: I've avoided all information about this film... I like to go in completely 'blind'!
records.translation: Iniwasan ko ang lahat ng impormasyon tungkol sa pelikulang ito... Gusto kong manood nang ganap na 'walang alam'!

records.source: Very interesting... I'll be pondering that one for a while.
records.translation: Lubhang kawili-wili... Matagal ko pa iyong pagninilayan.

records.source: It would be a lie to say I'm looking forward to this one...$s
records.translation: Magsisinungaling ako kung sasabihin kong sabik akong mapanood ito...$s

records.source: That was very mundane, don't you think?
records.translation: Napakapangkaraniwan niyon, hindi ba?

records.source: Hehe... I'd never turn down a free movie!
records.translation: Hehe... Hindi ako kailanman tatanggi sa libreng pelikula!

records.source: Ah, that reminds me of a story me ol' Pops used to tell...
records.translation: Ah, ipinaaalala niyan ang kuwentong dating ikinukuwento ng matandang tatay ko...

records.source: I'm excited to see this one... I want to learn everything about the world!
records.translation: Sabik akong mapanood ito... Gusto kong matutuhan ang lahat tungkol sa mundo!

records.source: Leo is glued to the screen!
records.translation: Hindi maialis ni Leo ang tingin sa iskrin!

records.source: Did you see that? They showed the fern islands... that's where I'm from!$h
records.translation: Nakita mo ba iyon? Ipinakita nila ang Kapuluan ng Fern... doon ako nagmula!$h

records.source: I'm really happy to be here. This is all so interesting!
records.translation: Masayang-masaya akong narito. Napakawili ng lahat ng ito!

records.source: Leo seems very interested in the movie.
records.translation: Tila interesadong-interesado si Leo sa pelikula.

records.source: Wow... it was like magic!
records.translation: Wow... parang mahika iyon!
